mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mountain WHERE mountain_id = #{mountainId} AND use_yn = 'Y')
SELECT count(*) FROM trail_node n WHERE n.mountain_id = #{mountainId} AND n.node_id IN (#{startNodeId}, #{endNodeId})

WITH path AS ( SELECT d.path_seq, d.node, d.edge FROM pgr_dijkstra( 'SELECT edge_id AS id, source_node_id AS source, target_node_id AS target, length_m::double precision AS cost, length_m::double precision AS reverse_cost FROM trail_edge WHERE pass_yn = ''Y''', #{startNodeId}::bigint, #{endNodeId}::bigint, true) d WHERE d.edge <> -1 ), traversed AS ( SELECT p.path_seq, e.edge_id, e.length_m, CASE WHEN p.node = e.source_node_id THEN e.fwd_time_min ELSE e.rev_time_min END AS time_min, CASE WHEN p.node = e.source_node_id THEN e.geom ELSE ST_Reverse(e.geom) END AS geom FROM path p JOIN trail_edge e ON e.edge_id = p.edge ) SELECT count(*)::integer AS edge_count, string_agg(t.edge_id::text, ',' ORDER BY t.path_seq) AS edge_ids, round(sum(t.length_m), 1) AS length_m, CASE WHEN bool_and(t.time_min IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(t.time_min) END AS est_time_min, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Transform(ST_MakeLine(t.geom ORDER BY t.path_seq), 4326), 7, 0) AS geometry_json FROM traversed t

WITH input AS ( SELECT ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326), 5179) AS geom ), nearest AS ( SELECT n.node_id, n.geom FROM trail_node n WHERE n.mountain_id = #{mountainId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trail_edge e WHERE e.pass_yn = 'Y' AND (e.source_node_id = n.node_id OR e.target_node_id = n.node_id)) ORDER BY n.geom <-> (SELECT i.geom FROM input i) LIMIT 1 ) SELECT nr.node_id, round(ST_Distance(nr.geom, i.geom)::numeric, 1) AS distance_m, round(ST_X(ST_Transform(nr.geom, 4326))::numeric, 7)::double precision AS longitude, round(ST_Y(ST_Transform(nr.geom, 4326))::numeric, 7)::double precision AS latitude FROM nearest nr CROSS JOIN input i WHERE ST_Distance(nr.geom, i.geom) <= #{maxDistanceM}
